WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia), ventas AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/30.0 AS vd FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art), stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_prv), riesgo AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.tot FROM stock s JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = s.art_cd AND a.art_crt = TRUE JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = s.art_prv JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = s.art_cd AND vt.vd > 0 WHERE s.tot / vt.vd < p.prv_dte) SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT r.art_cd ORDER BY r.art_cd) FROM riesgo r JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = r.art_cd WHERE r.tot > 0 AND e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (r.tot/3.0)

supuestos: Fecha de corte = MAX(vta_fch) de vtadia, 2026-09-26 (regla R-CORTE).

Riesgo: SKU crítico (art_crt) con cobertura menor que prv_dte del proveedor (R-RIESGO); se evaluó sin filtrar por punto de reorden, como indica la regla.
Excedente: existencia en un CEDIS > 1.5 × (stock total / 3), con stock total > 0 (R-EXCEDENTE).
